title: add downgrade guard and schema migration safety to private-installer upgrade tooling
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Motivation: customers running Private (VPC/on-prem) have seen failed upgrades when a newer DB schema introduces non-backwards-compatible changes or when an operator accidentally attempts to downgrade a control-plane version. This PR adds a downgrade guard, pre/post upgrade backup/restore hooks, and conservative schema migration enforcement to the private-installer upgrade toolchain. Changes include: 1) version pinning checks that compare target control-plane and DB schema versions and block downgrades unless --allow-downgrade is explicitly passed and operator confirms; 2) automated pre-upgrade snapshot using pg_dump + object-level checks and a restore path exercised by the e2e pipeline; 3) migration safety metadata: each SQL migration now includes a "downgrade_safe" flag and a short rationale; upgrade manager verifies migration ordering and aborts if an incompatible change is detected; 4) Helm hooks: added pre-upgrade job that performs backup and post-upgrade job that validates schema + service health; 5) minor Terraform module adjustments to surface the new lifecycle flags for infra automation; 6) docs and runbook additions describing rollback steps and operator prompts. Implementation notes: - upgrade manager (pkg/upgrade/manager.go) now fetches pinned versions from the installer config and refuses operations that would reduce the control-plane version in the cluster; - backup/restore scripts (scripts/backup_restore.sh) support incremental pg_dump and verify checksums; - new integration test (hack/e2e/installer_upgrade_test.go) simulates a 2-step upgrade with simulated migration failure to assert restore succeeds. Linear/Jira: ENG-7234 (upgrade safety) and ENG-7651 (backup/restore automation) track the work. Checklist: [x] pre-upgrade backup hook [x] downgrade detection and blocker [x] migration metadata and validations [x] helm hooks and chart updates [x] e2e test and CI job [x] docs + runbook.

release_notes: Operator-facing: Adds --allow-downgrade flag (explicit ACK required) and automatic pre-upgrade backups for Private installations. Upgrades now validate schema migrations and will block unsafe downgrades by default. See docs/upgrade.md and docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md for rollback steps.
